text:
Maria: quick thread - iterating run-history UI for structured outputs / tool calls. sketched three options, need fast feedback before figma mock.

Maria: goals: make it easy to tell which function produced which field, surface schema version, and avoid huge inline arrays.

Maria: option 1 - inline compact badge next to fn name (schema name + v#), small collapsed JSON preview expand on focus/click. shows a match score.

Maria: option 2 - field pills (type icons) that open a side sheet with full schema/examples. less cluttered in timeline.

Maria: option 3 - minimal, keep card, add header row with schema metadata + 3-dot -> view example. fastest to ship.

Alex: prefer option 1 for discoverability. question: arrays?

Samir: collapse arrays to "array[n]" pill and show first item in preview.

Jon: accessibility: no hover-only expansion. make pills keyboard-focusable, Enter/Space toggles, aria-expanded and aria-label summarizing fields. also add non-color indicators for match state.

Eve: copy tweak - microcopy: "Structured output (fields may map to tool calls)" and short badge like "schema v2 • invoice-parser". use icon + text for match: ✓ Matches / ⚠ Possible mismatch / ✖ No match.

Alex: add small red/orange indicator when match score < 0.7; show tooltip and link to example.

PlaygroundBot: preview ready https://staging.playground.redwood/preview/24901 - includes compact/invocation examples.

Maria: i'll mock figma A/B/C, include Jon's a11y checklist and add "Copy link to invocation" in 3-dot menu. PR by EOD.

Jon: posting checklist: tab focusable, Enter/Space expand, aria-expanded toggles, aria-describedby summary, text label for match state.

Maria: thanks! filing ticket PDX-3347 to track.
